# Jessica Higgins and Dan Wathne + Logan Bates
Date: 2026-09-17 | Duration: 26.209999084472656m

## Summary
The team resolved identity mapping, removing a major blocker and enabling a large experiment to compare Growth Book with existing analytics tools while reducing manual analytics work. Warehouse transformations currently run nightly despite raw data arriving hourly, so Pallabi Barua’s team is pursuing at least hourly updates; Growth Book’s event forwarder can support near-real-time streaming, although daily updates are usually sufficient unless traffic is extremely high. The pilot aims to demonstrate value to product and analytics teams, with the trial extended from the 19th to the 30th and weekly updates showing strong engagement. Analytics is the primary champion, while product is focused on requirements. A joint analytics review, potentially including product, is planned for Thursday or Friday next week. Jessica Higgins and Pallabi will follow up with Christina about contract readiness. The team also praised Growth Book’s low-pressure, product-first approach compared with competitors such as LaunchDarkly.

## Keywords
Growth Book, data pipeline, analytics, experiment, contracting, trial extension

## Action Items

**Jessica Higgins**
Follow up with Christina to get updates on the contracting process and current status (14:46)
Coordinate with Pallabi and Dan to schedule the analytics-focused experiment dashboard review/Q&A session next week (19:55)

**Pallabi Barua**
Assist Jessica with follow-up communication to Christina regarding contract status (14:46)
Confirm analytics team availability and coordinate with Jessica and Dan for the experiment review session that includes answering analytics questions on Growth Book usage (19:55)

**Dan Wathne**
Support scheduling and preparation for the analytics session and ongoing communication with Rula teams (21:00)

**Logan Bates**
Provide documentation and guidance on the new event forwarder feature to help enable near real-time data streaming to the warehouse (12:05)

# Jessica Higgins and Dan Wathne + 2 others
Date: 2026-11-10 | Duration: 26.389999389648438m

## Summary
GrowthBook analytics is live under a signed contract, with multiple experiments running and a simpler workflow than the previous process. Cary Rakin became the account manager and commercial escalation contact, while Chris Sanders will provide technical post-sales support, training, and onboarding help. Rula is setting up Okta integration and plans to evaluate GrowthBook as a LaunchDarkly replacement, targeting evaluation completion in January ahead of LaunchDarkly’s April renewal. The evaluation will cover holdouts, experimentation, feature flagging, consistent front-end and back-end bucketing, low-latency launches, SDK integration, and possible architectures such as GrowthBook Proxy or a shared library wrapper. Redshift-to-Snowflake migration and data-quality improvements remain important dependencies. An internal analytics workshop is planned for next month, with broader experimentation training targeted for early February. The team aims to expand adoption, reduce analyst workload, avoid impression-based pricing constraints, and document the evaluation and migration outcome in a case study after approximately three months of experience.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Feature flags, LaunchDarkly migration, Experiment analytics, Snowflake migration, Experimentation enablement
